div.head: Ine 34
div.ab: LXXVIII. Se (þe) on þære fóre wære, ðæt mon mon ofsloge, getriwe hine þæs sleges ⁊ þa fore gebete be ðæs ofslægnan were:
LXXVIII. Se ðe on ðære fore wære, þæt mon monnan ofsloge, getriewe hine ðæs sleges ⁊ ða fore gebete be ðæs ofslegenan wergielde:
Qui in collegio fuerit, ubi aliquis occisus sit, adcredulitet se, quod eum non percussit, uel emendet secundum occisi weregildum:
{LXXVIII} Se ðe on ðære fore wære þæt mon monnan ofsloge, getriewe hine ðæs sleges ⁊ ða fore gebete be ðæs ofslegenan wergielde.
He who was on a raid in which a man was killed, let him clear himself [by oath] of culpability for the death and compensate for his part in the raid according to the slain man’s wergild.

He who has been on a foray, which has resulted in a man being slain, must clear himself of the homicide and pay compensation for his participation in the foray, in proportion to the wergeld of the slain man.
Whoever was present on the expedition made for the purpose of killing a man, is to clear himself of the killing and pay compensation for the expedition according to the wergild of the slain man.
Wer bei der Fahrt war, wo man einen Menschen erschlug, der schwöre sich von dem Todtschlag rein und büsse die [Theilnahme an der] Fahrt je nach dem Wergeld des Erschlagenen:

Whoever was on the expedition on which a person was slain, let him clear himself by oath of the slaying and pay compensation for [taking part in] the expedition according to the wergeld of the slain man:
div.note: I take the subjunctive mood to suggest purpose rather than result.
